AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: DeDup finds and cleans up duplicate photos/videos, large files, and junk on the device. Operational Patterns: - Prefer 'getStorageSummary' first to get an overview of storage usage by media type before calling 'findLargeFiles' or 'findOldPhotos' for a detailed file listing, to avoid returning unnecessarily large result sets. Constraints: - All exposed functions are read-only; DeDup does not expose file deletion to agents.
